facts.text: Justine goes home and dreams at night about her space flight.
An expert is sitting in his car on the way back home from work.
The expert experiences horrible traffic on the way back home from work.
The expert thinks about how difficult it is to work with Justine.
The expert's mood darkens due to the horrible traffic.
The expert starts singing a sad song to himself.
The person who set the task is the boss.
The boss should reflect on his team’s knowledge.
The boss should use explicit attributions for his team’s qualifications.
